$comment: Hand-edited. The package's typed shapes are generated from it. tests/spec_sync/test_declaration_schema.py holds a field result's read members to read_result.json's, and case.json's build result and watch to this file's, member for member.
title: BuildReport
description: The build's report (declarations.md section 2): consumer, as declared; records, every record a read resolved; declaration, as given; refusals, the declaration's own (section 1); results, every field result of section 2 and every combination result of section 3 item 6; watches (section 8); and unused (section 2 item 9). watches is optional, so that a build that does not yet emit watches omits it rather than hold an empty list; every other list is required, and may be empty. A declaration the build refuses on its own gives no results, no watches and nothing unused, so a report holding a refusal holds those lists empty, its declaration as given where its text is JSON, and its consumer where the declaration declares one, whatever their shape. A report holding no refusal holds its consumer and a declaration valid against declaration.json.

records.description: Every record a read resolved, by id, version and content_hash.

refusal_rule.description: A report holding a refusal holds no results, no watches and nothing unused (section 2), and holds the declaration as given where its text is JSON and its consumer where the declaration declares one; one holding none holds its consumer, as declared, and its declaration, valid against declaration.json.

refused_declaration_rule.description: A refused report holds the declaration as given, but where its text is not JSON (section 2). Such a text is refused at the empty pointer alone (section 1); a schema cannot tell it from a declaration whose one fault is refused there too (one that is not an object, or lacks a member of the declaration's place), so a report whose refusals are that one refusal may omit the declaration.

refused_consumer_rule.description: A refused report holds its consumer exactly where the declaration it holds declares one (section 2).

build_refusal.title: BuildRefusalJson
build_refusal.description: A refusal of the declaration on its own (section 1): the case of the rule broken, a JSON pointer (RFC 6901) into the declaration, and optionally detail, text for people that no case compares.

field_result.title: BuildResultJson
field_result.description: A field's result (section 2): the read result, its members each as read_result.json gives it, with the build's members added: the model, the location it was read for (over records, the record read; a result read for a region or an interval holds it beside record), the field, its specimen differences, whether it is accepted and by which acceptances (0-based indexes into the model's acceptances), on a trainable field its trainable entry's index, and what nothing covers. Its status and reasons hold the build's own reasons joined to the read's (section 2 item 8).

trainable_by.description: The 0-based index of the result's entry in the model's trainable.

combination_result.title: CombinationResultJson
combination_result.description: A combination's result (section 3 item 6): the model, the location, the record, the fields combined, the specimen differences between them, and whether they are accepted, as a field result's are.

accepted_by.description: 0-based indexes into the model's acceptances, of every acceptance used for the result, those the read applied included (section 2 item 4).

not_accepted.description: Each reason and each specimen difference that nothing covers, empty exactly when accepted is true (section 2 item 4).

specimen_difference.title: SpecimenDifference
specimen_difference.description: A fact the target names where the record's differs (section 3): its section and fact, the record's fact, absent where the record does not hold it, and the target's.

watch.title: Watch
watch.description: A run-time watch (section 8): its model, its location (over records, the record read), the field and the condition, the condition's unit, its source, and either interval, the values the condition may take, its ends rounded inward to doubles, or accept, a token condition's accept list. Its interval member holds the watch's ends, never a location: a watch at an interval location is not yet specified.

watch_rule.description: Exactly one of interval, with the condition's unit, and accept, with none; and a location, the record unless a region.

unused_acceptance.title: UnusedAcceptance
unused_acceptance.description: An acceptance no result used (section 2 item 9): its model, by name, and its 0-based index in the model's acceptances.
